h1: Import plywood from India to Kenya, direct from Kochi
lede: Packing, commercial, shuttering and marine plywood, pressed in Perumbavoor and loaded 40 km from Cochin Port for Mombasa. USD quotes on FOB Cochin terms, answered within one business day.
tldr: TL;DR: Cochin Wood Industries is an Indian plywood factory exporting to Kenya. Packing-grade, commercial, film-faced shuttering and marine plywood ship FOB Cochin to Mombasa in full-container loads. Tell us the road weight limit for the inland leg and the loading plan is built to it. USD quotes, written reply within one business day.
faq: Which port do you ship to for Kenya?

Mombasa, unless you tell us otherwise. The discharge port is named on the quotation, and if you clear elsewhere we will quote against that routing. We ship full-container loads from Cochin; there is no local stock in Kenya to draw on.
How long does a container take from Kochi to Mombasa?

It depends on the carrier and the service, and we would rather confirm it for your booking than print a figure the next schedule change makes wrong. The sailing is confirmed alongside the quote, and shipping documents are shared before the vessel sails.
How many sheets will fit in my container for the inland run?

That is a weight question, not a volume one. Plywood reaches the permitted payload before it fills the box, so the answer turns on thickness, panel density, pallet weight and the road weight limit on your leg from the port. Send us that limit and the loading plan is built to it: sheets per container, net and gross weight, loose-loaded and palletised. It is on every quote.
What import duty will I pay on plywood in Kenya?

We do not state a rate for Kenya. We have never published one, and a wrong tariff is an expensive thing for a buyer to be handed. Duty and any import tax are set by the destination schedule against the line your goods are classified under, and applied at import. We state the HS code on the commercial invoice and issue the certificate of origin; your clearing agent confirms the line and the rate in force. We do not give customs rulings and will not promise a duty outcome.
Do you supply certification for import into Kenya?

Tell us what your import needs at enquiry, not after the goods are pressed. A certificate, test report or pre-shipment inspection decides which mill the order is placed with, and it cannot be added retrospectively. Each mill holds its own BIS licence; whatever applies to your order is named on the quotation by holder, number and product scope. Inspection by you or an agency you appoint is welcome and we hold the goods for it.
Do the plywood sheets need ISPM-15 treatment or fumigation for Kenya?

No. Plywood is a processed wood product and is exempt from ISPM-15, so the panels carry no heat-treatment stamp and need no fumigation certificate. The standard covers solid-wood packaging — pallets, crates, dunnage. Where we supply those, they are produced under an ISPM-15 compliant process with the marks and paperwork in order.
What are your payment terms for Kenya orders?

Standard products ship against 50% advance with the balance payable before dispatch; custom builds are 100% advance. We accept bank transfer (T/T), and all export invoicing is in US dollars. If you have not traded with us before, company verification lists every registration we hold and the government portal you can check it on.
